description: This PHP class 'tlTestPlanMetrics' encapsulates most of the functionality necessary to query and generate metrics related to test plans within the TestLink project. It includes methods for retrieving counters of test executions, statuses, priorities, milestones, keywords, platforms, test suites, and more, often involving complex SQL queries for detailed reporting. The class interacts heavily with the database and other classes to assemble detailed test execution metrics suitable for reporting and dashboard purposes.

classes.name: tlTestPlanMetrics
classes.description: Main class providing metrics and reporting functionalities for test plans, including execution status counts, milestone statistics, keyword and platform metrics, as well as complex hierarchical metrics suitable for detailed test reporting.

methods.name: getStatusConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration data for test case status labels and codes used in reports.

methods.name: getPrioritizedResults
methods.description: Returns counters for test results prioritized by urgency and importance for a given test plan and optional milestone dates.

methods.name: getMilestonesMetrics
methods.description: Calculates and returns metrics per milestone in a test plan, including execution counters, percentages, and test case priorities.

methods.name: get_percentage
methods.description: Helper method to calculate and format a percentage value given total and current counts.

methods.name: getOverallBuildStatusForRender
methods.description: Generates a visual report object summarizing overall build statuses for a given test plan.

methods.name: getExecCountersByKeywordExecStatus
methods.description: Fetches execution counters grouped by keywords and execution statuses, with options to filter and group by platform.

methods.name: getExecCountersByPlatformExecStatus
methods.description: Retrieves test execution counters grouped by platform and status, supporting filtering and grouping.

methods.name: getExecCountersByPriorityExecStatus
methods.description: Calculates execution counters based on priority levels, combining urgency and importance for a test plan.

methods.name: getExecCountersByBuildUAExecStatus
methods.description: Provides execution counters per build and user assignment, including durations.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsByKeywordForRender
methods.description: Prepares a rendered object summarizing status totals for keywords within a test plan.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsByItemForRender
methods.description: Generates report objects for specified item types (keyword, platform, priority) with status counts.

methods.name: getStatusTotalsByPlatformForRender
methods.description: Prepares a visual report object of status totals grouped by platform.

methods.name: getExecCountersByTestSuiteExecStatus
methods.description: Fetches execution counters grouped by test suite and status for a given test plan.

methods.name: getExecStatusMatrix
methods.description: Builds a detailed matrix of execution statuses across test suites, test cases, and platforms, including latest execution info.

methods.name: helperGetExecCounters
methods.description: Internal method to assist in retrieving execution counters with various filters and options; only partially available in the chunk provided.

methods.name: getExecTimelineStats
methods.description: Retrieves execution timeline statistics, including counts and workforce data, over different time granularities (day, month, day_hour).

methods.name: getExecTimeSpan
methods.description: Calculates the earliest and latest execution timestamps for a given test plan within specified context dimensions such as platform, build, or other.
